subject: Logic 13 control-bar role and complete read-only transport census
question: Does the upgraded host expose the transport-bearing control bar through the same AX role and topology as Logic 12, and can the product select it without accepting the same-named view-toggle container or hiding unread branches?

reverify.command: With Logic 13 running an owned disposable project and no menu open, build the debug product candidate, capture the main-window Control Bar scope read-only, run the atlas comparison against the prior qualified Control Bar snapshot, and run the read-only selection census. Do not press a control, type, save, close the project, or change locale.
reverify.expected: The scoped snapshot resolves one transport-bearing Control Bar root, contains one Play control, drops no atlas pair and reports reuseFull. The independent selection census resolves that same Control Bar while the same-named view-toggle-only container is not selected. An unrelated leaf button whose AXChildren read returns AXError.failure does not hide the candidate; an unread container, missing role, depth truncation or a second capable candidate still refuses authority.
reverify.cost: Read-only Accessibility snapshots and product probes against the already-open disposable project; no Logic input, project write, save, close or locale change.

method: Built a debug product candidate from base dcd104036fd2ce86e2ffe1f65dda5ef296463bcb plus the bounded Control Bar correction (six-file patch SHA-256 e156af054c737d6f21ae11599c5877384f9b252e7de1d67ea6c97de361a485b4; binary SHA-256 a604e3a1b92e16d1932e774e52f5fefa39de9b3b58ae01f2737bf3425d73606f). The product performed a read-only scoped snapshot, an atlas comparison and a selection census against the already-open disposable project. No keyboard, pointer, AX action, setter, save, project close or locale change was sent. Synthetic tests separately injected the observed unrelated leaf failure and the fail-closed container, metadata, depth and ambiguity cases.
conclusion: On this Logic 13 host the transport-bearing Control Bar is the top-level AXToolbar, while a same-named AXGroup carries view toggles and must not win by name or tree order. The corrected locator and approval transport observation resolve the capable toolbar through a complete role census, tolerate only an AXChildren failure on a freshly verified terminal button role, and preserve fail-closed handling for unread containers, malformed metadata, depth truncation and ambiguity.
limits: One Logic 13.0 build 7801 host and ko-KR only; this does not establish the topology of another Logic build or locale.
The live run is read-only and qualifies discovery plus transport observation. It does not press Play or Record, change project state, or qualify every operation that later consumes the Control Bar.
The terminal exception is restricted to a freshly read AXButton role. No absence, malformed-role, container-read, permission, depth or ambiguity guard is relaxed.
The evidence files are retained qualification artefacts identified by SHA-256; they are not canonical Apple string evidence.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record measures runtime Accessibility roles, topology, read failures and selection behavior. It does not add or change Apple label vocabulary or claim a string-corpus value.
